posts_body_or_tombstone.name: posts_body_or_tombstone
posts_body_or_tombstone.value: "posts"."body" is not null or "posts"."deleted_at" is not null

connectors_approved.name: connectors_approved
connectors_approved.value:
("connectors"."status" <> 'active' or "connectors"."approved_at" is not null)
        and ("connectors"."status" <> 'pending' or "connectors"."approved_at" is null)

grades_released.name: grades_released
grades_released.value: ("grades"."state" = 'released') = ("grades"."release_id" is not null and "grades"."released_at" is not null)

users_kind_shape.name: users_kind_shape
users_kind_shape.value:
("users"."kind" = 'user' and "users"."email" is not null and "users"."owner_user_id" is null)
        or ("users"."kind" = 'preview' and "users"."email" is null and "users"."owner_user_id" is not null)
